title: E6 five-minute planning checkpoint form B
instructions: Continue with the Neighbourhood Youth Website prompt about using one school-learned idea to improve how people share a community space. Make both compact-planning decisions before submitting.

parts.prompt: Which pair of body-paragraph jobs best develops the community-court booking-board focus?

options.text: Body 1: record when and why clashes occur before changing anything. Body 2: test a one-week booking board, compare the new pattern and explain whether access became clearer.
Body 1: describe the history of basketball. Body 2: list every sport played in the neighbourhood.
Body 1: state that fairness matters. Body 2: repeat the same statement with different adjectives.
Body 1: propose rebuilding the court. Body 2: change the topic to school laboratory rules.

choice_rationales.A: The first paragraph establishes evidence, and the second applies and evaluates the same observe-before-changing idea.
choice_rationales.B: Sports background does not explain the chosen school-learning transfer.
choice_rationales.C: Repeated general claims provide neither specific evidence nor development.
choice_rationales.D: The costly new proposal and topic shift abandon the selected focus.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: The effective body route moves from observing the real pattern to testing and evaluating one bounded change.

parts.prompt: Which final audit note best proves that the plan is ready to draft?

options.text: One school idea, one community space, one specific situation and the possible result all appear; each body paragraph has a distinct job, evidence and link-back.
The introduction is already polished, so missing prompt requirements can be added later.
The plan contains many connectors, even though the evidence and paragraph jobs are unclear.
A new central example has been saved for the conclusion.

choice_rationales.A: This checks task coverage, paragraph purpose, evidence and explanation before drafting begins.
choice_rationales.B: Surface polish cannot compensate for missing task requirements.
choice_rationales.C: Connectors do not create a logical route without clear jobs and evidence.
choice_rationales.D: A conclusion should close the existing response rather than introduce a new centre.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: A ready plan covers the full task and gives every paragraph a distinct evidence-bearing role connected to one focus.
